event.description: Use cosine-normalized attention with one QKV union
event.proposal: Family: attention organization. Current retained frontier is 1,640 parameters at 99.000000%, exactly threshold (+0.000000 margin). There have been 20 prior macro-attempts in this family. The most recent accepted relevant result is attempt-0146/micro-0011 at 1,640/99.00%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0150/micro-0001, whose next QKV union scored 98.97% at 1,639. The nearest same-pair boundary is QKV 608/539 at best 98.99%. Hypothesis: learned query/key vector norms amplify sensitivity to one tied scalar; cosine-normalizing Q and K preserves angular routing while removing norm dependence. Add pair 608/539, normalize each head's Q/K vectors, retain causal softmax and values, yielding 1,639 parameters. This is more informative than another temperature calibration because it changes the score geometry directly after six local temperatures failed.
